node.subject: english
node.title: 一般过去时: 规则变化
node.content_req: 在第二学段 (3~4 年级)教学情境中,掌握规则动词过去式 -ed。
key_points: 在第二学段 (3~4 年级)教学情境中
能在句子或短语中识别哪些动词属于规则动词 (而非不规则动词)
能在 '昨天发生的动作' 情境中, 把规则动词正确改写为一般过去式填入句子
node.academic_req: 能在描述过去发生的事件情境中, 识别规则动词并将其一般过去时形式 (-ed) 正确写入句子空格, 并说明该词形变化的依据.
node.assessment_prompt: 句子 Yesterday I ___ (watch) TV at home, 空格应该怎么填, 为什么 watch 加 ed 而不是加 s, {{name}}试试?\n用 play, study, walk 三个动词各造一个「昨天发生的事」的句子, 注意看他们变过去式时拼写有没有变化, {{name}}试试?\n{{name}}能举个例子吗?
node.title_pinyin: yi ban guo qu shi :  gui ze bian hua
node.description: 规则动词的过去式就像给动词「贴邮票盖邮戳」—— 昨天发生的事要「寄回过去」, 所以动词后面必须贴一张 -ed 的邮票. work 变成 worked, play 变成 played, 孩子一旦发现「大
node.real_examples: 人教版 PEP 四年级下册 Unit 6 『Shopping』 Part B Read and write, 课本 Sarah 一家去超市的日记里写『Yesterday I shopped with my mum. We bought so
node.common_mistakes: 学生常把 play 写成『play』 (应为 played); 以 e 结尾的 like 写成『liked』中漏 e 变『likd』; 双写规则最容易错, 学生写『stop』过去式成『stoped』 (应双 p 写 stopped);
node.teaching_activity: 准备 12 张单词磁贴 (walk / play / like / stop / cook / shop / watch / wash / clean / jump / dance / help),
node.teaching_voice: 我们来看,把'昨天发生的事'搬到现在说,动词后面就得贴一张 -ed 的邮票。想象昨天放学回家,你'I played'足球,妈妈'I cooked'晚饭,人人都要盖章。记住,看见 yesterday 就想 -ed,规则动词别忘贴邮票!

exercises.question: Yesterday I ____ football with my friends after school. Which word is correct?
exercises.explanation: yesterday 表示过去,规则动词 play 要加 -ed 变成 played。A 是现在时,B 是第三人称单数,D 是现在进行时,都不对。

exercises.question: Look! Yesterday Mum ____ dinner for us. The verb 'cook' should change to its past form.
exercises.explanation: 规则动词 cook 末尾已经有 -k,-ed 直接接上,变成 cooked, 表示 '昨天做了晚饭'。

exercises.question: Please write one sentence about something you did yesterday, and underline the verb in past form.
exercises.answer: Yesterday I watched TV at home. / Yesterday I cleaned my room. (动词加 -ed: watched, cleaned)
exercises.explanation: 1. 句子要有 yesterday 提示过去时间。 2. 动词必须用规则动词的过去式 (-ed)。 3. 正确标出该动词。

exercises.question:
Yesterday was Children's Day. Look at the picture and complete the sentences with the correct past tense of the verbs in the box.

play   watch   visit   dance

1) I _______________ games with my friends in the park.
2) My mum _______________ a movie at home.
3) We _______________ Grandpa on Children's Day.
4) The children _______________ happily at the party.
exercises.answer:
1) played　2) watched　3) visited　4) danced

审题: 题干给出四个动词,要求填入昨天发生的事的句子中,用过去式。
分析: play/watch/visit/dance 都是规则动词,直接加 -ed;但 watch 和 visit 末尾是 -t/-d 音,要读作 /t/ 或 /id/。
解答: 规则动词过去式一律加 -ed,play→played, watch→watched, visit→visited, dance→danced,四个空依次填入即可。
exercises.explanation: 1. 审清题意: 四个空都是"昨天发生的事",必须用过去式 (考察时态判断)。2. 识别规则动词: play/watch/visit/dance 都是规则变化 (考察规则动词的辨认)。3. 正确加 -ed: 直接加 -ed,无需去 e 或双写 (考察 -ed 拼写规则)。4. 词形完整正确,时态一致 (评分时任何拼写错误扣分)。

exercises.question:
Yesterday Lin Tao had a busy day. Read his diary and choose the correct answer.

It was sunny yesterday. In the morning, I _______ (cook) breakfast for my mum. Then I _______ (clean) the room. In the afternoon, I _______ (play) football with Tom. In the evening, I _______ (watch) TV with my family. We were all happy yesterday.

Question: Which of the following is TRUE?
A. Lin Tao didn't help his mum yesterday.
B. Lin Tao played football in the morning.
C. Lin Tao watched TV with his family yesterday evening.
D. Lin Tao cleaned the room in the afternoon.
exercises.answer:
C

审题: 根据 Lin Tao 日记内容判断哪个选项正确。
分析: 四个动词都应改为过去式: cooked, cleaned, played, watched;A、B、D 三个选项都与日记内容矛盾。
解答: 日记明确写 In the evening, I watched TV with my family,选项 C 与之完全一致;A 错误,因为 He cooked breakfast;B 错误,因为下午才 play football;D 错误,因为上午就 clean the room。故选 C。
exercises.explanation: 1. 审题: 题目要求选"正确"陈述,要回到日记原文逐句对照 (考察细节理解)。2. 概念应用: 四个动词 cook/clean/play/watch 都是规则动词,过去式加 -ed,体现本概念"昨天发生的事贴 -ed 邮票"。3. 排除法: A 与 He cooked breakfast 矛盾;B 与 in the afternoon 矛盾;D 与 in the morning 矛盾;C 与 In the evening, I watched TV 完全吻合 (考察时间状语与动词的匹配)。4. 综合评价: 正确选项必须时态、动作、时间三项都一致,缺一不可。
